message: The angular target does not support default-slot-presence: Angular has no API for whether `<ng-content>` received content, and forwarding the default slot would re-project `<ng-content />`, which always counts as content (ADR-0056).
The qwik target does not support default-slot-presence: Qwik's `<Slot />` has no presence API, and forwarding the default slot needs its presence (ADR-0054).
